newsitem.title: USA: GE consumer financial unit names president.
newsitem.headline: GE consumer financial unit names president.

text.p: GE Capital Services said Monday that it has appointed Kathryn Marinello as president of its Capital Consumer Financial Services group in Mason, Ohio.
Before joining GE, Marinello was with First Data Corp as president of the electronic payments group, GE said.
She succeeds Michael Schauer, who left the company about two months to join First Virtual, a San Diego, California, company in which GE Capital has a small interest, said GE spokeswoman Mary Horne.
GE Capital Consumer Financial Services develops and sells consumer bankcards such as the Exxon MasterCard. It also develops and sells corporate bank cards and home equity lines of credit.
Separately, General Electric Co said that retired U.S. Senator Sam Nunn has been named to the GE board.
Nunn, who retired after 24 years in the U.S. Senate, brings the number of GE board members to 15, the company said.
